text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, dropping the shears like that...
I'm so glad... the flowers weren't harmed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... I can't keep my focus...
I should ask someone else to handle the grooming—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seems so fatigued that even caring for her flowers has become difficult. We should probably review her future schedule.
